rule: clear = at least 80% of the field's pixels clear; water = S2 SCL water (class 6) or Landsat QA water share of the field; a spring counts as wet if a clear view is >= 50% water or its field-median NDWI > 0.3
summary: In 11 springs (Mar-Jun, 2016-2026) no clear Sentinel-2 or Landsat view showed the field flooded; the most water seen on a clear day was 0% of the field (spring 2021). Estimate from the satellites' own water masks and NDWI, not NASA OPERA DSWx.

source.title: Sentinel-2 L2A scene classification and Landsat C2 L2 QA water, field share per scene (backend/field caches; estimate in place of OPERA DSWx)

note: Estimated from the Sentinel-2 scene classification (water class) and the Landsat QA water bit, field share per scene (data/cache/<id>/s2.parquet, landsat.parquet), plus NDWI > 0.3 on the field median; NASA OPERA DSWx was not processed for this BC field. Spring (March-June: snowmelt and the Salmon River freshet) only, as for the California fields.
